text_block_list.text:
Here it is, the long-awaited Arima Kinen!
And out
of all the Umamusume chosen
to participate, the
one making headlines
is...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
The Beast, Грасс Вандер! Everyone is on
the
edge of their seats, eagerly awaiting
her clash
with her biggest rival, Special
Week!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Calm. And very much so. You
could say
I've found my comfort zone.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the moment when
the
starting gate opens.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm both grateful and honored to share
the
racecourse with such worthy
competitors.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
But most importantly, I will press
forward.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win... This is my race!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Let's give this race our all!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
You two look excited. Don't get too
down on
yourselves when I turn out the
winner.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
For me, losin' here ain't an option.
Comprenden?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Here it is: the fanfare of the Arima
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
